nodes.description: The first mouse model of Laing distal myopathy.

The initiating lesion is a heterozygous MYH7 variant, usually in the light meromyosin (LMM) region of the coiled-coil rod toward the 3' end of the gene (exons 30-40). Laing alleles are characteristically proline substitutions (Arg1500Pro, Arg1560Pro) or single-residue in-frame deletions (Lys1617del, Glu1508del, Lys1729del); myosin storage alleles are distal-rod missense changes (Arg1845Trp, His1904Leu, Leu1793Pro). The mutant heavy chain is expressed and incorporated, so ClinGen classifies the mechanism as dominant negative.

nodes.description: A single, selective and non-length-dependent pattern of muscle involvement. Clinically and on MRI the tibialis anterior and extensor hallucis longus are affected first and constantly, with variable later spread to the thigh (sartorius, quadriceps), hip, paravertebral, calf and scapulohumeral muscles, and with intramuscular fat replacement. Why these muscles are selectively vulnerable when MyHC-I is expressed in every slow fibre is not explained.
